goal: Conduct research on a historical figure using library databases, university websites, and academic courses.

eq.subject: Inquiry about sitting in on your Picasso lecture
eq.body: Dear Dr. Miller, I am conducting research on Pablo Picasso and saw that you specialize in his work. I would appreciate the opportunity to sit in on one of your lectures regarding Picasso if possible. Please let me know if this would be alright. Thank you!
